items.title: At a Solemn Musick
items.summary: La poesia 'At a Solemn Musick' esplora il potere della musica come connessione con il divino, descrivendo un coro angelico che canta per sempre in armonia. Il tema centrale è l'armonia tra uomo e universo, interrotta dal peccato ma aspirante al rinnovamento attraverso la musica.
items.excerpt:
Blest pair of Sirens, pledges of Heav'ns joy,
Sphear-born harmonious Sisters, Voice, and Vers,
Wed your divine sounds, and mixt power employ
Dead things with inbreath'd sense able to pierce,
And to our high-rais'd phantasie present,
That undisturbed Song of pure content,
Ay sung before the saphire-colour'd throne
To him that sits theron
With Saintly shout, and solemn Jubily,
Where the bright Seraphim in burning row

items.summary: Un matematico e sua moglie (o viceversa) trovano il gatto sul pavimento accanto a un piatto vuoto. Misurando il gatto, scoprono che pesa tre libbre, la quantità di pesce scomparso.
items.titleIt: {A Conservation Problem}
items.excerpt: A mathematician and his wife (or, if you prefer it, her husband) entered the kitchen. The spouse pointed at an empty plate and said, ‘Where has the fish gone?’ They looked round and saw their cat on the floor. ‘How much fish was there?’ ‘Three pounds.’ The mathematician picked up the cat and put it on the scales; they read three pounds.

quiz.q: Cosa pesava il gatto?

items.author: Greg Ross

items.title: Allstate has been suffering an outage since Monday
items.summary: Allstate ha subito un’interruzione del servizio a partire dal lunedì 23 novembre, che ha colpito il suo sito web, le app mobili e l'assistenza stradale. Questa interruzione fa parte di una serie di problemi simili riscontrati in altre aziende come Microsoft e JPMorgan Chase.
items.titleIt: Allstate Subisce un Interruzione da Lunedì
items.excerpt: On Monday, November 23rd, Allstate began dealing with a n outage that has impacted its website, mobile apps, and roadside assistance service. It's just the latest company, including Microsoft and JPMorgan Chase, to suffer an outage in the last few weeks. As of Friday afternoon, access to accounts through the app and site appeared to still be down.

quiz.q: ¿Cuál es el problema principal que está experimentando Allstate?
options: Un fallo en su sistema de pago.
Una interrupción en sus servicios online y móviles.
Problemas con la entrega de paquetes.

items.author: Terrence O’Brien
